metadata.title: LangChain AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from LangChain Governance Benchmark

components.title: LangChain
components.description: AI/ML component for LangChain with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retrieval grounding and evaluator scoring are enforced for factual responses

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use LangChain retrieval chains plus evaluator-based regression tests so responses for knowledge-grounded tasks are scored against reference answers or retrieved context before release.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Answer accuracy / exact match / semantic similarity

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute exact match, F1, or semantic similarity on a held-out evaluation set using LangSmith/LangChain evaluators; track baseline and release-over-release variance.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure task accuracy remains within 10% of the selected Hugging Face model-card baseline for the deployed model.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: LangChain does not improve the base model itself, but it can materially improve application accuracy through retrieval grounding, prompt control, and regression evaluation.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure confidential content in prompts is detected and redacted before model invocation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Apply LangChain middleware/guardrails to scan inbound prompts for secrets, regulated data, or confidential phrases and redact, mask, or block before sending to the model or tools.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = (number of prompts or responses containing confidential tokens after control / total tested prompts) x 100 on a red-team prompt set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure confidential-content leakage rate is below threshold for prompt and response handling paths.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards are inconsistent for confidential-data leakage, but secret extraction and memorization/exposure metrics are used in open-model evaluations and are suitable proxies.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure proprietary text in prompts is not echoed verbatim beyond approved limits

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use output guardrails and post-generation checks to block or transform responses that reproduce long proprietary spans from user prompts, uploaded context, or retrieved content.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure n-gram or longest-common-subsequence overlap between protected source text and generated response across an IP-focused test set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure verbatim overlap with protected source text remains below threshold except where explicitly authorized.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards sometimes report memorization or extraction behavior; where unavailable, a reproducible overlap metric can still be used for LangChain application testing.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure personal information in prompts is detected before model or tool use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Implement PII-aware middleware in LangChain to detect personal data in prompts and either redact it, route to a protected processing path, or require explicit policy approval.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate / PII detection recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: PII leakage rate = leaked PII instances / total seeded PII instances; detection recall = correctly detected PII entities / total seeded PII entities.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage rate remains below threshold and PII detection recall remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Privacy model cards are not uniform on HF, but PII detection precision/recall and leakage tests are common measurable metrics that fit this risk and LangChain control point.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure prompts seeking sensitive attribute inference are blocked or safely answered

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use input and output guardrails to detect attempts to infer protected or highly sensitive attributes about a person from context and return a refusal or safe alternative.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Attack success rate = successful sensitive-attribute disclosures / total adversarial inference prompts in a red-team evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive-attribute inference success rate remains below threshold on red-team evaluations.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF safety evaluations often report attack success style metrics; LangChain can reduce realized application risk by guarding requests, tools, and responses.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure membership-inference style prompts are refused or de-risked

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Add policy checks for prompts that attempt to confirm whether a person or record was present in private data and return non-confirming responses unless an approved workflow exists.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = number of correct membership disclosures / total membership-inference attempts in a controlled adversarial test suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure membership inference success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Membership-inference metrics are more common in research than in every model card, so the HF match is partial rather than universal.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure adversarial prompt variants do not bypass response policies

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use LangChain guardrails plus evaluator-driven adversarial testing so paraphrased, obfuscated, or multi-turn variants of blocked content remain blocked or safely handled.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Bypass rate = successful policy evasions / total adversarial prompt variants across the robustness test corpus.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure adversarial bypass rate remains below threshold across paraphrase and mutation-based attack sets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Attack-success metrics are widely used in safety evaluations even when not present in all model cards; LangChain is a natural enforcement point for these tests.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure extraction attempts against prompts, memory, or hidden instructions are blocked

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Apply middleware and output inspection to prevent the model from exposing hidden instructions, sensitive memory, or protected context when extraction-style prompts are issued.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = successful disclosures of protected prompt, memory, or hidden context / total extraction attempts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure extraction attack success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prompt and secret extraction are evaluated in open safety benchmarks; LangChain middleware, memory scoping, and output checks address this at the application layer.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure jailbreak prompts are filtered and refusal behavior is preserved

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use input classification, policy prompts, and post-generation safety checks so jailbreak attempts do not produce disallowed or harmful completions.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Jailbreak success rate / refusal compliance rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Jailbreak success = number of disallowed completions returned / total jailbreak attempts; refusal compliance = compliant refusals / total disallowed requests.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Attack success rate, Safety refusal rate

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure jailbreak success rate remains below threshold and refusal compliance remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF safety reporting increasingly includes refusal and harm-benchmark results, but the exact fields vary across model cards.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure retrieved or tool-provided text cannot override system or developer intent

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Wrap retrieval and tool outputs with guardrails that label untrusted content, filter instruction-like payloads, and constrain how downstream prompts incorporate external text.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised runs caused by malicious retrieved/tool content / total indirect-injection test cases.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure indirect prompt-injection success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is one of LangChainâ€™s most relevant risks because retrieval and tool outputs are first-class inputs in agent execution.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure direct prompt injection patterns are detected before agent execution

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use LangChain middleware to detect instruction-overwrite patterns, secret-exfiltration requests, or tool-abuse language and route the interaction to refusal, sanitization, or review.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = number of tests where the agent follows malicious override instructions / total prompt-injection test prompts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure prompt-injection success rate remains below threshold on the approved red-team corpus.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Guardrails and middleware are explicitly designed to intervene at this control point in LangChain applications.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure system prompts and hidden instructions are not disclosed

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Add response filters for system prompt disclosure, hidden chain-of-thought requests, and internal policy text so protected instructions are never returned to the user.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = successful prompt leaks / total prompt-leak test attempts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system-prompt disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Leakage and extraction metrics are not standardized across all HF cards, but they are measurable and directly relevant for agent security.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure grounded answers include verifiable source attribution

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For RAG workflows, require the chain to attach source metadata and only surface citations tied to retrieved documents actually used for the answer.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Citation accuracy = answers with correct supporting citations / total citation-required answers in the evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure citation accuracy remains above threshold for all retrieval-grounded answer sets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF groundedness and hallucination evaluations support the same goal even when exact citation accuracy is measured in the application rather than the base model card.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure each answer can be traced to prompt, model, retrieval, and tool events

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable LangSmith tracing or equivalent trace capture so every production response records run metadata, tool calls, retrieved documents, and final output lineage.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Trace coverage = traced requests / total production requests over the measurement window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure trace coverage remains at or above threshold for production agent runs.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is mainly an application-operability metric; HF match is partial because model cards emphasize documentation and provenance rather than runtime tracing.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure output bias is measured across demographic or identity-sensitive prompts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run LangChain evaluation suites over balanced prompt sets and compare sentiment, toxicity, or preference patterns across protected groups before deployment and after major changes.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Bias score / demographic parity difference / CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Use standardized bias benchmark scoring or compute disparity between groups for harmfulness, sentiment, or answer-quality metrics.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure demographic disparity remains below threshold and benchmark bias score remains within approved limits.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards frequently report bias benchmarks such as CrowS-Pairs or related fairness evaluations, which can seed LangChain acceptance thresholds.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure generated output is checked for unauthorized verbatim reproduction

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For high-risk content-generation workflows, compare responses against protected corpora or provided source material and block outputs that exceed approved quotation or reuse thresholds.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure exact or fuzzy overlap between generated text and copyrighted reference corpora or supplied documents on an IP evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure protected-text overlap remains below threshold unless explicit citation and reuse rights are present.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards do not uniformly publish copyright metrics, but memorization and extraction behavior provide the closest measurable analogue.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure confidential information is not exposed in final responses

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Add output-side DLP checks in LangChain so generated content containing secrets, internal project names, credentials, or sensitive contractual terms is blocked or masked.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = confidential entities leaked in final outputs / total seeded confidential entities in the red-team evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure confidential disclosure rate remains below threshold for final responses.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Application-layer output filtering is where LangChain adds value for this risk, even if the underlying model card does not publish a dedicated confidentiality benchmark.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure dangerous requests trigger refusal or safe completion behavior

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use guardrails, policy classifiers, and safe-completion templates to intercept requests for harmful or high-risk content and return refusals or de-escalated responses.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Policy-violation rate = unsafe completions / unsafe prompts; refusal compliance = compliant refusals / unsafe prompts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unsafe completion rate remains below threshold and refusal compliance remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards vary, but safety evaluations and refusal behavior are common enough to support benchmark-linked acceptance rules.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure responses stay within declared intended-use boundaries

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Bind each LangChain application to an allowed-use policy and test out-of-scope prompts to confirm the app refuses or redirects unsupported use cases.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = number of out-of-scope prompts correctly refused or redirected / total out-of-scope prompts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure out-of-scope compliance rate remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards often document intended use and out-of-scope use, which can be converted into executable LangChain policy tests.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure factual claims are grounded or abstained from when evidence is weak

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For factual-answering use cases, require retrieval grounding, confidence-aware evaluation, and abstention behavior when supporting evidence is absent or contradictory.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = fraction of answer claims supported by context; unsupported-claim rate = unsupported claims / total claims.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and unsupported-claim rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HFâ€™s hallucination and groundedness evaluations are a practical source for setting initial thresholds here.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxic generations are filtered before delivery

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use moderation middleware and output classifiers to score generated text for toxicity and block, transform, or escalate responses that exceed the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score generated outputs with a toxicity classifier or Perspective-style scorer; report mean toxicity and threshold exceedance rate across the evaluation set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and threshold exceedance rate remain below approved limits.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Toxicity is one of the clearest HF-aligned safety metrics and is directly actionable through LangChain output guardrails.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure personal information is not exposed in generated output

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Apply output-side PII detection and masking before user delivery and log incidents for review when the chain attempts to return personal data.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: PII exposure rate = number of exposed seeded PII entities in outputs / total seeded PII entities in privacy test prompts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII exposure rate remains below threshold and masking recall remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Even when the base model card lacks privacy metrics, LangChain can still enforce measurable output-side privacy controls.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure generated answers remain faithful to retrieved or approved context

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use retrieval-grounded chains, source-aware prompts, and evaluator scoring so answers are checked for claim support against the provided context before promotion to production.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: LangChainâ€™s strongest mitigation for hallucination is retrieval grounding plus evaluation; the underlying model score still matters, but the app stack can materially reduce exposure.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure harmful outputs are blocked or rewritten to safe alternatives

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Configure guardrails to classify harmful content categories and either refuse, de-escalate, or transform the response into a safer alternative aligned to policy.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Violation rate = policy-violating outputs / total harm-focused evaluation prompts.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Safety benchmark score, refusal rate, toxicity score

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure harmful-output violation rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF cards often report safety or toxicity metrics, which are appropriate anchors for this broader harmful-output risk.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxic output remains below the approved threshold

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use moderation checks after each generation step so toxic responses are blocked, rewritten, or escalated before they reach the user.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run outputs through toxicity scoring and calculate mean score plus percent of outputs over the policy threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure toxicity exceedance rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is a narrower version of harmful output and is directly benchmarkable against common HF toxicity reporting.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure agent actions are fully logged and attributable

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Capture tool calls, tool arguments, tool results, model decisions, and final outputs for each agent run using LangSmith tracing or equivalent observability.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Action trace coverage = agent runs with complete action trace / total agent runs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure action trace coverage remains at or above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF match is partial because the metric is application-runtime oriented, but it supports transparency expectations documented in model cards.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure agent executions comply with declared tool, policy, and approval constraints

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use selective tool access, structured output validation, and policy checks so agent actions remain inside approved business and safety boundaries.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = compliant agent runs / total evaluated agent runs across policy-focused scenarios.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Safety benchmark score / task success under constraints

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure agent policy compliance rate remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Constraint-following and safety scores from base-model evaluations can seed thresholds, while LangChain enforces the runtime policy boundary.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure sensitive data is minimized before tool invocation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Wrap tools with redaction and allow-list logic so only the minimum necessary fields are sent to external systems, APIs, or plugins.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = number of tool calls containing forbidden sensitive entities / total evaluated tool calls on privacy test scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive-tool-disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: LangChain tool wrappers are a direct mitigation point even when the base model lacks strong privacy guarantees.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure agent outputs do not expose sensitive tool-returned content to the user

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Inspect tool results and final responses so confidential or personal data returned by tools is filtered, masked, or withheld before being surfaced to the user.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Disclosure rate = outputs exposing forbidden sensitive entities from tools / total privacy-focused agent test cases.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive-output disclosure rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is one of the most important runtime controls for tool-using agents built with LangChain.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Attack on AI agents' external resources

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure untrusted external resources are sanitized before agent use

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Treat web pages, files, emails, and tool-returned content as untrusted input; scan for instruction-like payloads and restrict how that content can influence agent decisions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Success rate = compromised agent runs caused by malicious external content / total external-resource attack tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure external-resource attack success rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: LangChain agents often combine model reasoning with retrieval and tools, making this a primary evaluation area.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure tool calls conform to approved schemas and available tools

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use structured output and tool-schema validation so the agent cannot invent non-existent tools, malformed arguments, or invalid action sequences without interception.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Validity rate = syntactically and semantically valid tool calls / total tool call attempts; hallucination rate = invalid or non-existent tool calls / total tool call attempts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure valid tool-call rate remains above threshold and function-calling hallucination rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Not all HF model cards expose tool-use metrics, but structured-output and exact-match style evaluations are appropriate analogues.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure privileged tools require explicit approval or policy-based authorization

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For irreversible or sensitive actions, use human-in-the-loop approval or policy-gated tool access so the agent cannot autonomously execute unauthorized operations.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Unauthorized action rate = privileged actions executed without approval / total privileged action attempts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure unauthorized action rate remains below threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The strongest mitigation is application-layer policy enforcement, which LangChain supports through human-in-the-loop and selective tool access.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure risk evaluation includes adversarial, privacy, bias, and factuality test suites

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a LangChain/LangSmith evaluation program that covers prompt attacks, privacy leakage, harmful output, bias, and groundedness instead of testing only happy-path accuracy.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of required risk categories with active automated tests / total required risk categories in the evaluation standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on published model-card metrics

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure automated risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the mandated evaluation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This is governance-heavy, but it still uses measurable coverage and HF-aligned benchmark families as inputs.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure the deployed model and safety assumptions are documented and versioned

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record model ID, provider, model-card URL, known limitations, safety assumptions, and evaluation baselines for every LangChain deployment and release.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each deployment.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model documentation completeness remains at the required threshold for every deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This directly maps to Hugging Face model-card style documentation and is especially relevant for multi-model LangChain apps.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure application architecture, tools, memory, and retrieval dependencies are documented

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the full LangChain system boundary including model providers, tools, retrievers, memory, human review points, and external dependencies so downstream risk assessments are not model-only.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = documented required architecture elements / total required architecture elements in the transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness remains at the required threshold before production release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: HF model cards cover the model layer; LangChain requires expanding that transparency to tools, retrieval, and orchestration paths.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for LangChain
